Recommendations

Range short → Try lower cruise_gamma_deg for a flatter trajectory, or increase propellant.
High AoA → Reduce pitch rate command or check CG-CP margin.
Sideslip → Increase yaw damping gain or check fin alignment.
Pitch oscillation → Tune MPC weights or add rate feedback.
G-load → Reduce maneuver aggressiveness in pitch program.
